text:
tori-sales: New RFP response in: BigBank wants BYO HSM with per-deployment attestations and configurable rotation windows down to 1 hour. They want clear optics on latency and a POC. Can ENG + SRE + Sec propose constraints?

devin-eng: Architecturally ok. We'll implement envelope encryption where our runtime requests ephemeral DEKs from customer's KMS via a secure proxy. We'll cache wrapped DEKs for configurable TTL. No plaintext keys persisted.

sam-security: Requirements list from RFP: mTLS for keystore connections, signed attestation including vendor/serial/fw + timestamp, audit log export, and must support split-key (optional). Also want a key-rotation webhook when they rotate their CMK.

maya-sre: Perf note: remote KMS adds tail latency. With a 2s network RTT added to HSM call, our p95 could jump; caching helps. We'll need to model region-to-region variance.

elaine-solutions: Pricing Q: they want a deterministic committed monthly price. Our pricing team needs usage scenarios. Also they asked if Redwood can provide a fallback KEK when HSM unreachable (with documented SLA degradation).

devin-eng: Fallback possible: we issue a local ephemeral KEK generated in a secure enclave and rotate it on reconnection. But legal/security may balk; need explicit contract permission.

sam-security: Noted. Also need to ensure attestation exchange process: customer provides signed attestation; we verify cert chain and store a reference only. Propose we require attestation on initial onboarding and weekly thereafter or on each deploy depending on request.

doc-bot: Uploaded: /files/rfps/byok-response-template-v2.docx

elaine-solutions: POC acceptance criteria suggestion: 1) No plaintext key at rest; 2) p95 end-to-end <30ms additional overhead compared to baseline; 3) Rotation test: force rotate customer CMK and ensure cache invalidated within 5s; 4) Attestation verification pass.

maya-sre: I'll run synthetic tests with various cache TTLs (30s, 1m, 5m) and report HSM call rate and p95. Expect tradeoffs visible.

tori-sales: Action list: Devin write architecture + sample TLS command; Sam prepare security questionnaire answers & attestation verification steps; Maya perf numbers; Elaine cost scenarios and fallback policy; I'll consolidate into RFP response.

devin-eng: Will include sample openssl s_client, example webhook payload for rotation, and sample config knobs for TTL and fallback.

sam-security: Blocker: contracts require explicit attestation storage policy; flagged legal.

tori-sales: Ok escalate to legal and aim to submit RFP in 4 business days.

elaine-solutions: Also buyer asked about HSM vendors we support and whether we can work with HSM-as-a-service providers like CloudHSM vs on-prem Thales. We'll enumerate supported vendors and caveats.

devin-eng: We'll note differences: cloud providers may have regional availability, on-prem may require network tunneling and different cert provisioning.

maya-sre: Preliminary numbers: with 500 TPS and 1m TTL cache, HSM calls drop 300x; p95 delta ~8-12ms depending on region. Will refine.
